neighbours.label: Rare CJK characters mid-sentence in Japanese/Chinese text (e.g. 仕, 釜 in 釜山, 袖, 笑, 送, 装), plus Korean ' 등'; a sparse multilingual token detector that fires mostly in a closed-gate regime
